title: STATEMENT OF RECORD
rule: one sentence says who he is, every clause cites a decision, and each decision corrects itself as it is read
description: A three-line statement on a forest band is the identity line; each clause cites a decision, and the fourth clause cites the store apps. The band also carries the tally, so the first screen shows 0 of 4 corrected turn to 1 of 4 when the first card corrects itself. Seven decisions follow as big cards; the three with no screen (0004, 0003, 0001) live in the record of ten. A decision with a real constraint shows it with one dotted underline; when the card reaches the reading line the constraint is struck and the result writes in after it. The band hands off to a one-line forest header whose cite lights for the current card.
signature: Literata and one technical mono. Mint ground, one forest band with mint type on the first screen, forest pills for the current cite and id, and one accent green for the words a clause cites. Cites and the tally hang in a 200 px margin, the same margin that holds each decision id; on the phone they sit in one row under the statement, which runs full width at 26 px with a non-breaking hyphen in multi‑tenant (six whole lines). Plates: the real claims screen of the care platform (invented data; the patients ring on the phone), the real Design System v2 buttons and alerts at their own width on a white band, a 16 → 2 number plate, and one Viva Fresh store image in a side-column card whose 528 px column holds the result, iOS and Android, from one React Native codebase. Motion: S3 band into header (scroll-linked; statement out over 0 to 112 px, header in over 112 to 172 px on desktop, 0 to 140 and 140 to 196 on the phone, so no frame holds both), S6 correction once per card (strike 260 ms word by word, stopped at the last glyph of each line, write-in 340 ms after 220 ms). The tally swaps its number, no fade. Keyboard jumps and reduced motion switch state with no travel.
holdback: Lowest: original, 7/10. The frame is still a well-set report: a colour band over a column of cards, ids in a margin. Polish cannot move that line. Hooks rose to 8 only because the tally now starts on the first screen; the device is still a text device. Open: the write-in clip can cut a glyph at a sampled time (d-load-0010-420ms, "both ap"; the canon allows it); the side-column result is a second big-type plate next to 16 → 2, so two of seven cards use the same figure device; the desktop header shows the full statement only from 1320 px, below that the name and the four cites.
